questions.question: What is the pro-ration factor applied to subsidised treatments for permanent residents undergoing continuation of Autologous Bone Marrow Transplant for Multiple Myeloma under the Medishield program?
What type of phone calls to 1800 service lines are free of charge in Singapore under the given conditions?
questions.answer: Calls made from regular land lines are free of charge.

questions.question: Who among the following family members is eligible to pay your MediShield premium using their MediSave? a) Cousin b) Parents c) Uncle
Where can patients receiving radiotherapy for cancer find information on approved indications for Proton Beam Therapy?
questions.answer: Patients can find this information on the MOH (Ministry of Health) website.

questions.question: What additional coverage do Integrated Shield Plans by private insurers provide beyond MediShield Life benefits?
questions.answer: Integrated Shield Plans provide additional coverage beyond MediShield Life benefits, as offered by private insurers.

questions.question: As of which date is the information provided in the MediShield Life booklet accurate according to the source citation?
If the claimable amount under the Medishield program is $12,000 and the deductible is $2,000, how much remains after the deductible is applied?
What is one financial benefit of joining the MediShield Life scheme at an earlier age?
questions.answer: Joining the MediShield Life scheme earlier results in higher premium rebates.

questions.question: What income range per month per person classifies individuals as lower-income for subsidy calculations in Singapore's MediShield program?
What is the maximum MediShield Life premium increase allowed by the end of the third year of the review cycle, compared to premiums in 2024?
If an individual is hospitalized twice in the same MediShield policy year, does the policy cover both hospitalisation events?
questions.answer: Yes, MediShield provides coverage for multiple hospitalisation events within the same policy year, subject to policy limits and exclusions.

questions.question: What is one purpose of the approach used in Singapore's MediShield program as described in source citation 2?
questions.answer: The approach helps to distribute premiums more evenly throughout one’s life and moderate the premium increases during older ages when one becomes less economically active.

questions.question: Who has the authority to impose and vary terms and conditions for the administration of the MediShield Life scheme in Singapore?
questions.answer: The CPF Board has the authority to impose and vary terms and conditions for the administration of the MediShield Life scheme, as provided for in the legislation.

questions.question: How is the MediShield Life claim computed for an insured member staying in Ward A regarding daily ward and treatment charges?
questions.answer: It is computed based on 27% of the bill for daily ward and treatment charges.

questions.question: What ensures that individuals do not lose MediShield Life coverage despite an inability to pay insurance premiums?
questions.answer: No one will lose MediShield Life coverage due to an inability to pay insurance premiums.

questions.question: Under Singapore’s MediShield Life Scheme, which type of medical procedure is explicitly excluded from coverage?
questions.answer: Cosmetic surgery is explicitly excluded from coverage under the MediShield Life Scheme.

questions.question: What specific cost component of MediShield Life do applicable subsidies also cover, as stated in the fact?
questions.answer: The applicable MediShield Life premium subsidies also cover the Additional Premiums.

questions.question: For how long is the Phased Support program provided to all Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents under the Medishield program?
questions.answer: The Phased Support program is provided for two years to all Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents.
